answer: A harbour master appointment with vessel movement logs works as the gate: movements logged at one harbour across seasons. Each of 226 aliases needs its own movement logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Call it the signal rule: fakes pay per head, the honest pay once, the raven record is open for audit, and the nebula window is too short for 226 aliases to earn their price back.
